description: Apply this skill whenever you need to design test cases using Use Case Testing — a black-box test design technique that derives test cases from use case specifications. Use when given a use case specification (or equivalent: user story with acceptance criteria, feature with defined actor-system interactions), and the goal is to ensure the system correctly handles all flows: the main success scenario, alternate flows, and exception flows. Triggers include: "design test cases from use case", "test this user story", "test this feature end-to-end", "use case testing", "UC", "actor interaction", "flow testing", or any request to test a feature where behavior is described as a sequence of actor-system interactions leading to a defined goal.
